snippet.title: The 'Family Friendly' Streamer Went Full Psycho in GTA 6 (Nick Eh 30) #Shorts
snippet.description:
Gameplay: Nick Eh 30 - https://www.twitch.tv/nickeh30
Go follow Nick, all footage and reactions are his. This channel is not affiliated with Nick Eh 30 or Rockstar Games.

The "family friendly" streamer polices a burnout in GTA 6... his way. Funny, but GTA 6 tracks every kill on your Criminal Profile.

What's confirmed:
- 5 Criminal Profile levels: Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, Irredeemable (PC Gamer, GameSpot)
- At Psycho you can't surrender to the cops anymore (GameSpot, PC Gamer)
- A crack on the Psycho icon means Irredeemable is next (GameSpot)
- Irredeemable is permanent, so keep a backup manual save before a rampage (GameSpot, PC Gamer)
- Reported, not tested by us: PC Gamer's endings guide lists Professional profiles for both characters as one requirement for the happiest ending
